ns2:course.label: Spanish in the Professions
ns2:course.description: Introduction to Spanish in business, law/law enforcement, medical, education & social service fields, with a focus on the importance of bilingualism in the U.S., strategies for lifelong learning, and culture considerations. The development of functional use of Spanish within the professional context is the major focus of the course. Recommended for students who want to take SPAN 202. Students who plan to major or minor in Spanish should take SPAN 141. Credit is not given for both SPAN 142 and SPAN 141. Prerequisite: SPAN 103 or equivalent.
